# Linkbreakers CLI

The `linkbreakers` binary is the official CLI for the Linkbreakers API. Every API operation is a command,
generated from the API's OpenAPI document: `linkbreakers <service> <operation> --help` lists its flags.

Start in one command, no account needed:
- `npx -y linkbreakers-cli signup --email <the person's email>` creates a free workspace and saves its API token.
  The person receives a link and a 6-digit code to claim it, by email only, so claiming also verifies their address; unclaimed, it is deleted after 24 hours.
- Then: `npx -y linkbreakers-cli links create --destination https://example.com --name "My link"`
  (`linkbreakers ...` once installed with `npm install -g linkbreakers-cli`)
- Analytics: `npx -y linkbreakers-cli analytics-data --help`, `npx -y linkbreakers-cli metrics --help`

Already have an account:
- Create a token at https://app.linkbreakers.com/workspace/dashboard/api-tokens
- `linkbreakers auth set-token --token <token>` or set `LINKBREAKERS_TOKEN`

Install:
- npm: `npm install -g linkbreakers-cli` (the npm package `linkbreakers` is the TypeScript SDK, not the CLI)
- Homebrew: `brew install linkbreakers-com/tap/linkbreakers`
- Script: `curl -fsSL https://cli.linkbreakers.com/install.sh | bash`
- Binaries: https://github.com/linkbreakers-com/linkbreakers-cli/releases

Output is JSON. Errors print the API's code and message, which say what to do next.

Docs:
- `README.md`
- `docs/commands/linkbreakers.md`
- Agent skills: https://github.com/linkbreakers-com/agent-skills
